regions.cleaned_text: God bless you Miss Muriel Krausman. Thanks be to God things have brightened in a number of ways, especially in relation with poor little Mary Jane. Indeed, thanks be to God. However, I rather - I do not like that idea of a second O. I know of more than one such "Miracles" where the doctor's efforts at improve- ment has turned fatal. About 20 yrs. back a certain Thomas Ryan of Pittsburgh, Penn. was passed all hope of operation. His in-laws phoned from St. Rose Parish Detroit and we enrolled him ... To their astonishment he went back to work without any operation. After two weeks work, the doctors induced him to go finish up on the X.R. Same T.R .-- Same T. Ryan got a relapse and died. I have known of several such cases. Be grateful to God, therefore, and attribute miracles to whom they due. I hope Drs. find further surgery uncalled for. There is a similar case related in the "life" of our stigmatic - P. Pio. A certain poor, good woman was quite hopeless with can- cer. She and her Husband went to Padre Pio and she was cured. Afterwards (I presume) without consulting Padre Pio and she got sick again and P. Pio said he could, he could do nothing.
